player_prompt.intro: You are playing Slitherlink on a {R}x{C} grid! Draw a single continuous loop so each numbered cell has that many bordering edges. Toggle the idges with: [h r c] - toggle vertical edge above dots at row r, column c [v r c] - Toggle horizontal edge left of dots in row r, column c Numbers show required edge count '.' means no constraint. You have up to {max_turns} moves to solve the puzzle.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Bad action format. Use [h row col] or [v row col].

outcome.win: You formed a single loop! puzzle solved!
